lines.zh: 骨头一节一节地挪，声响很远。
lines.en: My bones shift joint by joint, and the sound carries far.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草叶都发灰。
lines.en: Where I pass, the grass turns ashen.

lines.zh: 左腿少了一截，走起来偏。
lines.en: A length is missing from my left leg, so I list.

lines.zh: 别数我的步子，数不清的。
lines.en: Don't count my steps; they can't be counted.

lines.zh: 黑烟从肋骨缝里往外漏。
lines.en: Black smoke leaks out between my ribs.

lines.zh: 骨头磨着骨头，就是我的呼吸。
lines.en: Bone grinding on bone — that is my breathing.

lines.zh: 我不急，反正你跑不掉。
lines.en: I'm in no hurry; you can't outrun me anyway.

lines.zh: 每一步都压得地面发闷。
lines.en: Every step makes the ground groan dully.

lines.zh: 这具身体旧了，可还站得住。
lines.en: This body is old, but it still holds up.

lines.zh: 跟着我留下的枯痕走。
lines.en: Follow the withered trail I leave.

lines.zh: 我等了很久，骨头都干了。
lines.en: I've waited so long my bones dried out.

lines.zh: 风穿过胸腔，发出低低的口哨。
lines.en: Wind passes through my chest and whistles low.

lines.zh: 数着骨节，数到十七就忘了。
lines.en: I count my joints and lose track at seventeen.

lines.zh: 凋零的气味，我自己也闻得到。
lines.en: Even I can smell the withering on me.

lines.zh: 有块骨头松了，先不管它。
lines.en: One bone is loose; I'll ignore it for now.

lines.zh: 光线落在我身上，会暗一截。
lines.en: Light dims a notch when it falls on me.

lines.zh: 我记得自己曾是别的东西。
lines.en: I remember being something else once.

lines.zh: 这里太安静，安静得发痒。
lines.en: It's too quiet here — quiet enough to itch.

lines.zh: 我的影子比身体更完整。
lines.en: My shadow is more whole than my body.

lines.zh: 骨头在长，慢慢地长回去。
lines.en: The bones are growing, slowly growing back.

lines.zh: 没人来，我就自己和自己说话。
lines.en: With no one here, I talk to myself.

lines.zh: 那点余烬还没熄，还热着。
lines.en: That last ember hasn't gone out; it's still warm.

lines.zh: 站久了，膝骨开始抗议。
lines.en: Standing this long, my knee bones start to complain.

lines.zh: 我把下巴搁在手上，等。
lines.en: I rest my jaw on my hand and wait.

lines.zh: 骨缝里长出一小簇黑苔。
lines.en: A little black moss is growing in my joint.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，指骨少了一节。
lines.en: I lift a hand and one finger bone is gone.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛还在转，真好。
lines.en: Your eyes still move — how nice.

lines.zh: 凑近些，让我看清你的骨头。
lines.en: Come closer, let me see your bones.

lines.zh: 你身上那股热气，隔三步就闻得到。
lines.en: I smell the living warmth on you from three paces off.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我数得清。
lines.en: Don't blink; I can count them.

lines.zh: 你站得笔直，是不知道自己面对什么。
lines.en: You stand straight, not knowing what faces you.

lines.zh: 我看你很久了，从你进这片地。
lines.en: I've watched you since you entered this land.

lines.zh: 你的手在抖，藏到背后也没用。
lines.en: Your hands shake; hiding them won't help.

lines.zh: 活人的脸，我快忘了怎么读。
lines.en: I've nearly forgotten how to read a living face.

lines.zh: 你把武器握反了，我不提醒。
lines.en: You're holding your weapon wrong; I won't say so.

lines.zh: 骨头告诉我，你会留下。
lines.en: The bones tell me you'll stay.

lines.zh: 抬头，我要看清你的下颌。
lines.en: Look up; I want to see your jaw.

lines.zh: 你这副骨架，能撑很久。
lines.en: That frame of yours could last a long while.

lines.zh: 骨头裂了，但没断。
lines.en: The bone cracked, but it didn't break.

lines.zh: 打在这里没用，里面是空的。
lines.en: Hitting there is useless; it's hollow inside.

lines.zh: 你打断了哪一根？我数数。
lines.en: Which one did you break? Let me count.

lines.zh: 疼，是活人的事。
lines.en: Pain is a living person's business.

lines.zh: 碎屑掉了一地，我懒得捡。
lines.en: Splinters everywhere; I won't bother picking them up.

lines.zh: 这一下，让我想起自己还站着。
lines.en: That blow reminded me I'm still standing.

lines.zh: 缺口会自己长回来，慢慢等。
lines.en: The gap will grow back; wait slowly.

lines.zh: 别打关节，那里最脆。
lines.en: Don't strike the joint — that's the weak spot.

lines.zh: 我的骨头响，不是我在叫。
lines.en: My bones rattle; that's not me crying out.

lines.zh: 再来，这具身体挨得住。
lines.en: Again — this body can take it.

lines.zh: 递过来，我用两根指骨接。
lines.en: Hand it over; I'll take it with two finger bones.

lines.zh: 这点东西，不够我塞骨缝。
lines.en: That much won't fill the gaps in my bones.

lines.zh: 你举那么高，是怕我够到？
lines.en: Holding it that high — afraid I'll reach it?

lines.zh: 搁在石头上，手拿开，人退后。
lines.en: Leave it on the stone, hands off, then step back.

lines.zh: 我闻得出，这不是给我的。
lines.en: I can smell it isn't meant for me.

lines.zh: 想收买一具枯骨？
lines.en: Trying to bribe a pile of dry bones?

lines.zh: 我要的不是这个，是那根骨头。
lines.en: I don't want this; I want that bone.

lines.zh: 手别抖，掉了我就不捡。
lines.en: Steady your hand; if you drop it, I won't pick it up.

lines.zh: 你的供品，我记下了。
lines.en: Your offering is noted.

lines.zh: 再往前一寸，我就当是挑衅。
lines.en: One inch closer and I'll take it as a challenge.

lines.zh: 撞我，你自己的肩会先疼。
lines.en: Bump me and your own shoulder hurts first.

lines.zh: 让开，我的骨头不拐弯。
lines.en: Move aside; my bones don't turn.

lines.zh: 你贴得太近了，闻得到霉味吧。
lines.en: Too close — you can smell the mildew, yes?

lines.zh: 这一下，我连停都没停。
lines.en: That bump didn't even slow me.

lines.zh: 我的重量，你推不动。
lines.en: You can't push my weight aside.

lines.zh: 别挤，肋骨会卡住你。
lines.en: Don't crowd me; a rib will catch you.

lines.zh: 撞上来，算你有胆。
lines.en: Bumping into me takes nerve.

lines.zh: 退后，你踩到我的指骨了。
lines.en: Back up — you're standing on my finger bone.

lines.zh: 我不躲，躲了骨头会响。
lines.en: I don't dodge; dodging rattles my bones.

lines.zh: 路这么宽，你偏要撞我。
lines.en: The path is wide, yet you walk into me.

lines.zh: 另一具枯骨？走近让我看看。
lines.en: Another dry skeleton? Come closer, let me look.

lines.zh: 两副骨架并排，风都绕道。
lines.en: Two frames side by side, and the wind goes around.

lines.zh: 你的骨头比我白，是新死的？
lines.en: Your bones are whiter than mine — newly dead?

lines.zh: 我们不必说话，骨头会响。
lines.en: We need no words; our bones will speak.

lines.zh: 站到我左边，那边空着。
lines.en: Stand at my left; that side is empty.

lines.zh: 你也数不清自己的骨节吗？
lines.en: Can you not count your joints either?

lines.zh: 两具枯骨，能撑起同一片阴影。
lines.en: Two dry frames can hold up one shadow.

lines.zh: 靠过来，让风从我们中间过。
lines.en: Lean in; let the wind pass between us.

lines.zh: 这是凋零者之间的礼节。
lines.en: This is the courtesy between the withered.

lines.zh: 别急，骨头还要长一阵。
lines.en: Patience — the bones need time to grow.

lines.zh: 这根骨头，归我的收藏。
lines.en: This bone joins my collection.

lines.zh: 弯下腰，指骨咔地一响。
lines.en: I bend, and a finger bone clicks.

lines.zh: 掉了的东西，我不留在地上。
lines.en: What falls, I don't leave on the ground.

lines.zh: 掂一掂，这重量还算实在。
lines.en: I weigh it; the heft is decent.

lines.zh: 塞进肋骨里，正好卡住。
lines.en: It slots between my ribs and stays.

lines.zh: 这是我的，谁捡到都一样。
lines.en: It's mine; whoever picks it up, same thing.

lines.zh: 捡起来，吹掉上面的土。
lines.en: I pick it up and blow the dirt off.

lines.zh: 又多一块，身体又沉一分。
lines.en: One more piece, and my body grows heavier.

lines.zh: 地上那点东西，我从不放过。
lines.en: I never leave anything lying on the ground.

lines.zh: 拿稳，别让它再掉一次。
lines.en: Hold it fast; don't let it drop again.

lines.zh: 听见了，你的脚步乱了。
lines.en: I hear it — your steps have gone uneven.

lines.zh: 那片阴影在动，不是风。
lines.en: That shadow moves, and it isn't the wind.

lines.zh: 有一个活物，进了我的范围。
lines.en: Something living has entered my range.

lines.zh: 骨头开始发烫，是它来了。
lines.en: My bones grow warm; it has come.

lines.zh: 不用看，气味已经够了。
lines.en: No need to look; the scent is enough.

lines.zh: 那边的呼吸，太急了。
lines.en: The breathing over there is too quick.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，让骨头响给你听。
lines.en: I turn slowly, letting my bones sound for you.

lines.zh: 找到你了，躲得不算好。
lines.en: Found you — you didn't hide well.

lines.zh: 这具身体等这一刻很久了。
lines.en: This body has waited long for this moment.

lines.zh: 是你先踏进这块地的，记住了。
lines.en: You stepped into this ground first — remember that.

lines.zh: 距离不重要，方向才重要。
lines.en: Distance doesn't matter; direction does.

lines.zh: 我把头偏向你，颈骨响了一声。
lines.en: I tilt my head toward you; a neck bone pops.

lines.zh: 就是你了，别换人。
lines.en: You'll do; don't trade places.

lines.zh: 猎物的味道，和活人一样。
lines.en: Prey smells just like the living.

lines.zh: 那边的草倒了一片，不是风。
lines.en: The grass over there flattened, and it wasn't wind.

lines.zh: 我数到第二声心跳，就动身。
lines.en: I count two heartbeats, then I move.

lines.zh: 活人的热气，隔着林子也烫。
lines.en: The heat of the living carries through the trees.

lines.zh: 这具骨架认得猎物的方向。
lines.en: This frame of bones knows which way prey lies.

lines.zh: 一步，再一步，你就没退路了。
lines.en: One step, then another, and you've no way back.

lines.zh: 我不跑，我只一直走。
lines.en: I don't run; I simply keep walking.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角，我会等你。
lines.en: Back into the corner; I'll wait.

lines.zh: 骨节一节节收紧，像上弦。
lines.en: My joints tighten one by one, like winding a spring.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸越来越短了。
lines.en: Your breaths are getting shorter.

lines.zh: 这片地界，没有第二条路。
lines.en: This ground offers no second road.

lines.zh: 我把影子压过去，先罩住你。
lines.en: I push my shadow over you first.

lines.zh: 别浪费力气，跑不过我。
lines.en: Save your strength; you can't outpace me.

lines.zh: 每靠近一步，土就干一分。
lines.en: Each step nearer dries the soil a little more.

lines.zh: 我的手抬起来了，看见了么。
lines.en: My hand is rising — do you see it?

lines.zh: 就站在那儿，别让我追。
lines.en: Just stand there; don't make me chase.

lines.zh: 你数着我的心跳？我没有。
lines.en: Counting my heartbeat? I have none.

lines.zh: 快到了，我闻得到你的汗。
lines.en: Almost there; I can smell your sweat.

lines.zh: 这一战，我打算慢慢来。
lines.en: I intend to take this fight slowly.

lines.zh: 我不绕路，我只把路踩窄。
lines.en: I don't go around; I narrow the road.

lines.zh: 你数着退路，我数着骨节。
lines.en: You count your exits, I count my joints.

lines.zh: 再退半步，你的背就贴墙了。
lines.en: Half a step more and your back meets the wall.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声很轻，骨头却响。
lines.en: My steps are quiet, but my bones are not.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把，照不穿我。
lines.en: Your torch cannot see through me.

lines.zh: 我在等你先出手，那样省事。
lines.en: I wait for you to swing first; it is easier.

lines.zh: 这一掌，是骨头借给你的。
lines.en: This blow is bone lent to you.

lines.zh: 指尖划过，留下灰白的痕。
lines.en: My fingertips pass and leave an ashen streak.

lines.zh: 我不挥拳，我砸下去。
lines.en: I don't swing; I bring it down.

lines.zh: 肋骨张开，像一张旧弓。
lines.en: My ribs spread like an old bow.

lines.zh: 打中了，你的骨头会记住。
lines.en: It landed; your bones will remember.

lines.zh: 骨节脱开又接上，疼的是你。
lines.en: A joint pops loose and reconnects — you're the one hurting.

lines.zh: 抬手，落手，中间没有犹豫。
lines.en: Hand up, hand down, no hesitation between.

lines.zh: 我用整条前臂压过去。
lines.en: I bear down with my whole forearm.

lines.zh: 这一下不算重，下一记才重。
lines.en: That one was light; the next will be heavy.

lines.zh: 你想挡，可骨头比铁硬。
lines.en: You try to block, but bone is harder than iron.

lines.zh: 打偏了，只削掉一块皮。
lines.en: I missed and only scraped some skin.

lines.zh: 关节咔响，是我在发力。
lines.en: The click of my joints is me putting in force.

lines.zh: 让我看看你能挨几下。
lines.en: Let's see how many hits you can take.

lines.zh: 别倒太快，我还没尽兴。
lines.en: Don't fall too soon; I'm not done.

lines.zh: 骨头从土里一节节拼起来。
lines.en: Bones assemble themselves out of the soil, joint by joint.

lines.zh: 这具身体醒来时，先响了一声。
lines.en: When this body woke, its first act was a rattle.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋裂开，黑烟先出来。
lines.en: The spawn egg cracks; black smoke comes first.

lines.zh: 这具骨架重新立起，我又占住这块地。
lines.en: The frame rises again, and I hold this ground once more.

lines.zh: 头顶缺一块，风直接灌进来。
lines.en: A piece is missing up top; wind pours straight in.

lines.zh: 谁把我拼得这么歪？
lines.en: Who pieced me together so crookedly?

lines.zh: 我站起来了，地先塌了一寸。
lines.en: I stand, and the ground sinks an inch first.

lines.zh: 凋零的味道，从这里散开。
lines.en: The smell of withering spreads from here.

lines.zh: 眼睛的位置空着，但我看得见。
lines.en: The eye sockets are empty, yet I can see.

lines.zh: 这地方，从今天起归我。
lines.en: This place belongs to me from today.

lines.zh: 骨头还没干透，先活动一下。
lines.en: The bones aren't dry yet; let me loosen them.

lines.zh: 我把手指一根根掰直。
lines.en: I straighten my fingers one by one.

lines.zh: 别急着跑，我刚醒。
lines.en: Don't rush off; I've only just woken.

lines.zh: 这片地的草，要开始黄了。
lines.en: The grass here is about to turn yellow.

lines.zh: 土里翻出白骨，一根根归位。
lines.en: White bones turn up from the soil and settle into place.

lines.zh: 我睁眼之前，先闻到了活气。
lines.en: Before my eyes opened, I smelled the living.

lines.zh: 黑雾落地，剩下一具站着的架子。
lines.en: The black mist falls and leaves a standing frame.

lines.zh: 谁把我埋在这，我就从这起来。
lines.en: Whoever buried me here, I rise from here.

lines.zh: 骨节咔的一声，我算活过来了。
lines.en: My joints click once, and I count as alive.

lines.zh: 这块地空了很久，现在有我。
lines.en: This ground stood empty long enough. Now it has me.

lines.zh: 烧吧，干骨头烧得最旺。
lines.en: Burn, then; dry bones burn brightest.

lines.zh: 摔散了，捡起来还得半天。
lines.en: I've scattered; gathering myself will take a while.

lines.zh: 水里泡着，骨头会变沉。
lines.en: Soaked in water, my bones grow heavy.

lines.zh: 冲击把半边肋骨掀开了。
lines.en: The blast tore half my ribs open.

lines.zh: 那支箭卡在锁骨上了。
lines.en: That arrow is stuck in my collarbone.

lines.zh: 这股力量在啃我的骨头。
lines.en: This force is gnawing at my bones.

lines.zh: 饿不死的，我早就不吃东西。
lines.en: I can't starve; I stopped eating long ago.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，骨头都发白了。
lines.en: The bolt struck, and my bones turned white.

lines.zh: 往下掉，骨头比我先散。
lines.en: Falling — my bones come apart before I do.
